sc: Recurrent chest infections, clubbing, oily foul stools, salty skin → Cystic fibrosis: sweat test
Toddler eating peanuts, sudden choking, one-sided wheeze → Foreign body: rigid bronchoscopy
Wet cough from birth, ear infections, heart on the right → Kartagener syndrome
f: Meconium ileus (10–20%) · recurrent chest infections, clubbing · steatorrhoea, FTT · salt loss (hyponatraemic alkalosis in summer) · nasal polyps
Sweat chloride ≥ 60 mmol/L · newborn screening (IRT) · genetics · AR: 25% risk to each sibling
Physiotherapy · pancreatic enzymes, high-calorie diet, vitamins A, D, E, K · antibiotics (Pseudomonas: ceftazidime + tobramycin) · extra salt
Choking, then cough and one-sided wheeze · expiratory X-ray: hyperlucent lung (air trapping) · rigid bronchoscopy
Infant: 5 back blows, 5 chest thrusts · child: back blows, abdominal thrusts · effective cough: encourage, watch
Chronic wet cough, clubbing · HRCT · causes: CF, PCD, post-infection, foreign body
trap: A normal chest X-ray does not exclude a foreign body: bronchoscopy · one-sided wheeze in a toddler = foreign body until proved otherwise · no blind finger sweeps in a choking child
